notes: v1.0: MLBB-style file cards, step-by-step Add (file + name + picture, stored privately in the app), destination folder asked on entry and changeable any time, tap REPLACE/Copy replaces the same-named file in the chosen folder, in-app update (feed check + APK-pick install, same-signature gate). Scoped-storage limit: destination must be a folder the system picker can reach; another app's private folder cannot be written silently.
